events.title: Llywelyn the Last Is Killed at Cilmeri
events.description: Llywelyn ap Gruffudd, the last native Prince of Wales, was killed in an ambush near Builth Wells in mid-Wales while campaigning against the forces of England's Edward I.
events.significance: His death ended Welsh independence. Edward I soon conquered Wales and brought it under English rule.

events.title: Louis XVI Goes on Trial
events.description: The National Convention put King Louis XVI of France on trial for treason. The revolutionary government accused him of conspiring against the nation.
events.significance: The trial led to the king's execution in January 1793. It ended the French monarchy and radicalized the Revolution.

events.title: Indiana Becomes the 16th U.S. State
events.description: Indiana was admitted to the Union as the 16th state. It was carved out of the Northwest Territory.
events.significance: Its admission marked the growth of the young United States into the Midwest.

events.title: Statute of Westminster Enacted
events.description: The British Parliament passed the Statute of Westminster. It gave the self-governing dominions, including Canada, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, the Irish Free State and Newfoundland, the option of full legislative independence.
events.significance: It reshaped the British Empire into a Commonwealth of equal, self-governing nations.

events.title: Apollo 17 Lands on the Moon
events.description: Apollo 17, the final crewed Moon landing mission, touched down on the lunar surface. Its crew included geologist Harrison Schmitt and used the Lunar Roving Vehicle to explore.
events.significance: It was the last time humans walked on the Moon, and no one has returned in the decades since.
